body: $SVB $SIVB stock is down 20% pre-market after announcing a massive bond sale loss. This could trigger a bank run from VC depositors.
SVB Financial selling $21B of bonds at a $1.8B loss is alarming. $JPM and $BAC investors are watching closely for contagion.
$WFC $BAC $C $GS all down 2-4% in sympathy with SVB. Investors pricing in potential HTM bond losses across regional bank sector.
Bank run at $SVB accelerating. Over $40B in deposit withdrawals reportedly attempted Thursday. $JPM should be a safe harbor here.
Circle USDC briefly depegged because Circle had $3.3B in SVB. $GS and $JPM have no significant crypto exposure — big difference.
$BAC Bank of America has $109B in unrealised HTM bond losses. When do we start pricing that in? Different from SVB but worth watching.
$C Citigroup CEO Jane Fraser's track record of de-risking looks very smart right now. Citi has the most diversified international deposit base.
FDIC just seized SVB. Largest bank failure since 2008. $JPM $BAC $GS $C $WFC all halted pre-market. This is a systemic risk event.
Goldman Sachs $GS research note: SVB is idiosyncratic. VC-concentrated deposit base unusual. The big 4 banks are much better diversified.
$JPM JPMorgan is THE safe haven in this crisis. Biggest bank, most diversified, fortress balance sheet. Buying the dip here.
Talking to startup founders fleeing SVB deposits to $JPM $BAC $C. Velocity of deposit movement is extraordinary. TBTF banks are winning.
Sources: Treasury and Fed working through weekend on SVB depositor backstop. $GS Goldman analysts briefed on BTFP structure. Game changer.
Signature Bank just shut down. Second bank failure in 48hrs. $WFC Wells Fargo has $34B in unrealised HTM losses — bond market knows.
Fed's Bank Term Funding Program allows banks to borrow at par. Removes $BAC's $109B HTM loss risk overnight. Genius move or moral hazard?
BTFP backstop is bullish for $JPM $BAC $C $GS $WFC. Shorts covering hard. Regional bank crisis contained at the big banks.
$BAC Bank of America up 10% at open. $JPM JPMorgan up 5%. $C Citigroup up 6%. Bank crisis over for large caps? Markets think so.
$C Citi CEO confirmed zero direct SVB exposure. Jane Fraser runs a much tighter ship than people give credit for. Citi at 0.5x book is a gift.
Credit Suisse falling 15% in Europe but that is a completely different story from $JPM $GS $BAC. Different business model different risks.
$WFC Wells Fargo management reiterated no forced bond sales on analyst call. HTM losses are paper losses not cash losses. Overreaction?
$GS Goldman Sachs downgrading regional banks but upgrading $JPM and $BAC citing flight to quality deposit dynamics. Smart call.
Market now pricing 25bps March hike not 50bps after SVB. Fed pivot earlier than expected bullish for $BAC $C $JPM bond portfolios.
$BAC Bank of America: retail deposit outflows minimal. Corporate treasury clients showed some movement but retail base rock solid.
$WFC Wells Fargo still down 8% on the month despite reassurances. Market not buying the HTM loss narrative fully. Watch closely.
$JPM JPMorgan Q1 earnings estimates rising on deposit inflow data. Best positioned large cap bank coming out of this crisis.
Week in review: $JPM $BAC $C outperformed as safe-haven banks. $GS $WFC underperformed. Regional banks crushed. Fed BTFP changed the game.
